verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh chauraaseeh joon vich maanas janam dhula(n)bh upaiaa|

en.bdb: Among the eighty-four lacs of births, the human life is the rare one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਮਜਹਬਾਂ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan chaar majahabaa(n) hi(n)dhoo musalamaan sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: This human got divided into four varnas and dharmas and into Hindu and Muslim.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਮਾਰਿ ਅਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe purakh vakhaaneean naar sumaar aganat ganaiaa|

en.bdb: How many are the males and females cannot be counted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: trai gun maiaa chalit hai brahamaa bisan mahes rachaiaa|

en.bdb: This world is fraudulent display of maya who with its three qualities has created even Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾਂ ਵਾਚਦੇ ਇਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: vedh katebaa(n) vaachadhe ik saahib dhui raeh chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Hindus read Vedas and Muslims katebas but the Lord is one while two ways have been devised to reach Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਬਹੁ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: siv sakatee vich khel kar jog bhog bahu chalit banaiaa|

en.bdb: Out of the Siva-Sakti i.e. maya, the illusions of yoga and bhoga (enjoyment) have been created.
One gets good or bad results according to the company of sadh or evildoers he keeps.
